name: omp-session-control
description: Lets a local dashboard stop the running turn of an omp session and rename it, over a private Unix socket. Inert until you turn it on.

controlDir.description: Absolute path of the control directory. Empty means ~/.config/omp-session-control.

debugLog.description: Also write the text of unexpected errors (at most 200 characters each) to events.log. Off by default: that text can contain sensitive values.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Close a client connection that sends nothing for this many milliseconds (100 to 3600000).
